owner: ARPCE (Agence de Regulation des Postes et des Communications Electroniques)
notes: Data centre operated by the Congolese telecoms regulator at its headquarters in Brazzaville (approx. 6,232 sq ft building per DataCenterJournal); listed among three data centres in Brazzaville (with Ministry of Finance and MTN Congo) cited from ARPCE's own website (2021).
